Basel III endgame re-proposal 2026 Category III banks capital rule
Capital One Financial regulatory capital buffer 2026 SCB Discover

findings.claim: Fed 於 2026-02-04 通知各銀行將 SCB 維持現水準（待壓力測試透明化提案公開徵詢）；COF 的 SCB 為 4.5%，10-Q 稱維持至 2027-09-30，CET1／Tier1／總資本最低要求為 9.0%／10.5%／12.5%，反景氣緩衝 0%。
findings.excerpt: On February 4, 2026, the Federal Reserve notified all participating firms, including the Company, that because the Stress Testing Transparency Proposal remains subject to public comment, the Federal Reserve is maintaining stress capital buffer requirements for all such firms at their current levels.

findings.claim: Fed 2026 壓力測試結果（2026-06-24 公布）未改變 COF 的 SCB 要求；4.5% SCB 係在 Discover 併購完成前以 COF 單獨計算。
findings.source: Capital One Announces Stress Test Results (Business Wire, 2026-06-24)

findings.claim: 三大銀行監管機關 2026-03-19 發布 Basel III endgame 再提案：強制 ERBA 僅適用 Category I、II；Category III、IV 須將 AOCI 計入監管資本；另有標準法修正提案。搜尋未見最終規則。
findings.source: Simpson Thacher, Basel III Endgame Evolution (2026-03-20)

financial_regulatory_capital_rules.note: excerpt 僅第一條取自搜尋摘要原句，其餘為未取得逐字原文。Basel 再提案對 COF（Category III 推定）的 CET1 影響量未核實；二手來源稱區域銀行 CET1 要求約降 5.2%，未列入。

clues.claim: Fed 2026 壓力測試結果：COF 嚴重不利情境下 CET1 最低預測 11.0%。
